result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations on integral representations of solutions of a second-order differential equation (Gaussian-type integrals with powers), followed by saddle-point (steepest descent) estimates of integrals of the form $\int e^{-2yx-xx}x^{s-1}dx$, with a small sketch of an integration path.
